notes.title: Cricket Legends Update – Smarter Bowlers, Better Matches!
notes.notes:
Hey Legends! 👋
We’ve just bowled out a major update aimed at making your cricket matches more exciting, challenging, and rewarding!

🎯 What’s New – Improved Bowler AI!
The spotlight of this update is a smarter, more tactical bowler AI. Here's what to expect:

🧠 Adaptive Strategies – Bowlers now analyze your playstyle and adjust their deliveries accordingly.

🎯 Targeted Bowling – Expect more accurate yorkers, deceptive slower balls, and aggressive short-pitch deliveries when you're under pressure.

🕹️ Balanced Difficulty – Whether you're a casual slogger or a cricket purist, the AI now scales better to match your skills.

This makes batting feel more dynamic, with every over keeping you on your toes — no more predictable deliveries!

🔧 Other Improvements
Improved edge detection and better shot timing response.

Tweaked fielder positions to balance run scoring and wicket chances.

Minor visual polish and performance fixes.

notes.title: 🐧 Cricket Legends Now Available on Linux!
notes.notes:
Hey Legends!
We’ve got exciting news for our fellow cricketers on Linux — Cricket Legends is now officially available for Linux users! 🏏🎉

Yes, you can now enjoy the full Cricket Legends experience on your favorite open-source platform. We’ve tested and optimized the game for smooth performance across major Linux distributions.

🛠️ What's Included:
All game modes, features, and customizations
Seamless updates and patches with the rest of the platforms

📣 A Note to Our Linux Players:
If you run into any issues or bugs, please let us know via the Steam forums or Discord. We’re committed to making sure your cricketing experience is top-notch.

Thanks again for all your support — now go show the world that legends are made, not born... on every OS!

notes.title: Cricket Legends - Bug Fixes and Performance Improvements Update!
notes.notes:
Hello, Cricket Legends players! 🏏

We’re excited to bring you an update focused on making your gameplay experience smoother and more enjoyable. Here's what's been improved in this latest patch:

🛠️ Bug Fixes
* Corrected team stats and rankings display inconsistencies.
* Fixed fielders getting stuck in animations during high-pressure moments.

🚀 Performance Improvements
* Optimized gameplay for smoother frame rates across all hardware configurations.
* Reduced load times for matches and career mode progression.
* Enhanced multiplayer connectivity for a more seamless online experience.

What’s Next?
We’re committed to delivering the best cricket gaming experience. Your feedback plays a huge role in shaping our updates, so keep sending us your thoughts and suggestions! Stay tuned for upcoming content updates, including new features, tournaments, and more.

Thanks for your continued support. See you on the pitch! 🏏

Play hard, play fair, and become a legend!

– The Cricket Legends Team

notes.title: Final Build Transition
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce the official release of Cricket Legends! After extensive testing and feedback from the pre-release version, we’ve made a range of improvements, bug fixes, and enhancements to ensure the best possible cricket experience for all players.

[b]New Features:[/b]
* [b]Official Launch:[/b] The game is now fully launched and available for everyone!
* [b]New Cricket Modes:[/b] Added new modes T20, WorldCups, memorable matches for players to experience different styles of play.

[b]Improvements:[/b]

* [b]Visual Enhancements:[/b] Improved stadium lighting, player models, and ball physics for a more immersive cricket experience.
* [b]AI Adjustments:[/b] Enhanced AI for bowling, providing a more challenging and dynamic opponent.
* [b]Sound Design:[/b] Refined crowd reactions, bat-ball impact sounds, and commentary for a more authentic match experience.
* [b]Performance Optimizations:[/b] Reduced load times and improved frame rates for smoother gameplay on all systems.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
* Addressed crashes that occurred during match transitions and load screens.
* Resolved minor glitches in player animations and stadium details.


[b]Gameplay Tweaks:[/b]
* [b]Batting System:[/b] Tweaked the batting mechanics for a more intuitive control over shots and timing.
* [b]Bowling Mechanics:[/b] Adjusted bowling physics for more realistic ball movement, including spin and swing.
* [b]Match Balancing:[/b] Fine-tuned match length, fielding settings, and difficulty levels based on player feedback.


We are continuing to monitor and improve gameplay experiences for all players.
Thank you to our community for your support and feedback throughout development! We look forward to seeing you in the game and hearing your thoughts as we continue to improve Cricket Legends.
